title: CaptureMisPermissionsGrant v0.1
description: JSON Schema for the Capture-Manifest permission grant object (§10.2) and its revocation record (§10.3).

capture_manifest_version.description: Must match the Capture-Manifest spec version being implemented.

vendor.description: Vendor slug identifying the application that issued the grant (e.g., cursor, claude-code).

agent_key_id.description: SHA-256 of the capture agent's ed25519 public key. Format: sha256:<hex>.

granted_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the grant was issued.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the grant expires. Absent means no expiry.

allowed_kinds.description: Permitted capture kinds. At least one value required.

revocation_endpoint.description: URL to POST for real-time grant revocation.

grant_signature.description: Integrity signature over the grant object (minus this field). Format: sha256:<hex>.

revoked.description: True when this grant has been revoked (§10.3). Absent or false means active.

revoked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the grant was revoked. Required when revoked is true.
